# 3-Day Easy Vegetarian Meal Plan

This vegetarian meal plan provides approximately 1800 kcal per day, focusing on easy-to-prepare dishes and avoiding all nuts. It is designed for a single adult.

## Daily Nourishment (1800 kcal/day)

### Day 1: Thursday, August 1, 2024
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- **Breakfast (approx. 450 kcal):** Berry & Seed Oatmeal
  - 1/2 cup dry rolled oats cooked with 1 cup milk (dairy or non-dairy).
  - Topped with 1/2 cup mixed berries and 2 tablespoons chia seeds.
  - Optional: a touch of maple syrup or honey for sweetness.
- **Lunch (approx. 600 kcal):** Chickpea Salad Sandwich
  - 1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, mashed and mixed with 3 tbsp light mayonnaise or Greek yogurt, diced celery, diced red onion, and your favorite spices (e.g., curry powder, dill).
  - Served on 2 slices of whole-wheat bread with lettuce.
  - Side of 1 cup baby carrots.
- **Dinner (approx. 600 kcal):** Hearty Lentil & Vegetable Soup
  - 2 cups of homemade or store-bought lentil soup (made with brown lentils, carrots, celery, spinach, tomatoes, vegetable broth).
  - Served with 2 slices of whole-wheat bread.
- **Snack (approx. 90 kcal):** 1 medium apple.

### Day 2: Friday, August 2, 2024
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- **Breakfast (approx. 450 kcal):** Spinach & Feta Scramble with Toast
  - 2 large eggs scrambled with 1 cup fresh spinach and 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese.
  - Served with 2 slices of whole-wheat toast (lightly buttered).
- **Lunch (approx. 550 kcal):** Leftover Lentil & Vegetable Soup
  - 2.5 cups of the hearty lentil and vegetable soup from Day 1.
- **Dinner (approx. 700 kcal):** Black Bean & Corn Quesadillas
  - 2 whole-wheat tortillas filled with 1/2 cup black beans (rinsed), 1/4 cup corn, and 1/2 cup shredded cheddar or Monterey Jack cheese.
  - Cooked until golden and cheese is melted. Served with 1/4 cup salsa and 1/2 avocado, sliced.
- **Snack (approx. 70 kcal):** 1 medium orange.

### Day 3: Saturday, August 3, 2024
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- **Breakfast (approx. 450 kcal):** Greek Yogurt Parfait with Granola & Fruit
  - 1 cup plain Greek yogurt layered with 1/2 cup mixed berries, 1/2 cup nut-free granola, and 1 tablespoon honey.
- **Lunch (approx. 550 kcal):** Big Veggie & Egg Salad
  - Mixed greens base with cucumber, tomatoes, bell peppers, 1 hard-boiled egg (sliced), 1/2 cup roasted chickpeas (for crunch), and 3 tablespoons vinaigrette dressing.
  - Served with 1 whole-wheat pita bread.
- **Dinner (approx. 700 kcal):** Whole-Wheat Pasta Primavera
  - 2 cups cooked whole-wheat pasta tossed with 1.5 cups mixed seasonal vegetables (e.g., broccoli florets, zucchini slices, bell pepper strips), a light tomato-based sauce, 2 tablespoons olive oil, and 1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese.
- **Snack (approx. 115 kcal):** 1 large apple.
